{{Quote|May I suggest the Ondo Lava '39. An excellent, full-bodied wine, with just a hint of Dewback spritz.|A [[Waiter/Legends|waiter]] at the Lucky Despot|<ref name="GG7">''[[Galaxy Guide 7: Mos Eisley]]''</ref>}}
'''Ondo Lava''' was a rich, fruity [[Wine/Legends|wine]] popular around the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Hallena Devis]] liked the drink.<ref name="NP">''[[The Clone Wars: No Prisoners]]''</ref> The Ondo Lava '39 was considered to be a full-bodied wine with a hint of [[Dewback/Legends|Dewback]] spritz.<ref name="GG7" />
